statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cols=$(tput cols 2>/dev/null || echo 80); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); dirname=$(basename "$cwd" 2>/dev/null); branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); git_changes=$(git -C "$cwd" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l); unpushed=$(git -C "$cwd" log @{u}.. --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l); pr=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.pr.number // empty'); pr_state=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.pr.review_state // empty'); context=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // empty'); rate5=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); rate5_reset=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at // empty'); rate7=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); duration_ms=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_duration_ms // empty'); lines_added=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_lines_added // empty'); lines_removed=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_lines_removed // empty'); vim_mode=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.vim.mode // empty' | cut -c1); elapsed=""; if [ -n "$duration_ms" ] && [ "$duration_ms" != "0" ]; then secs=$((duration_ms/1000)); if [ $secs -ge 3600 ]; then elapsed=$(printf '%dh%02dm' $((secs/3600)) $(((secs%3600)/60))); elif [ $secs -ge 60 ]; then elapsed=$(printf '%dm%02ds' $((secs/60)) $((secs%60))); else elapsed=$(printf '%ds' $secs); fi; fi; reset_time=""; [ -n "$rate5_reset" ] && reset_time=$(date -d "@$rate5_reset" '+%H:%M' 2>/dev/null); lines_info=""; [ -n "$lines_added" ] && [ "$lines_added" != "0" ] && lines_info="+$lines_added"; [ -n "$lines_removed" ] && [ "$lines_removed" != "0" ] && lines_info="$lines_info/-$lines_removed"; line1=""; [ -n "$dirname" ] && line1="📁 $dirname"; [ -n "$branch" ] && line1="$line1  ⎇ $branch"; [ -n "$pr" ] && line1="$line1  PR #$pr${pr_state:+ ($pr_state)}"; [ "$git_changes" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && line1="$line1  📝 $git_changes"; [ "$unpushed" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && line1="$line1  ⬆ $unpushed"; line2=""; [ -n "$vim_mode" ] && line2="[$vim_mode]"; [ -n "$model" ] && line2="$line2 $model"; [ -n "$context" ] && line2="$line2 | 📈 Ctx:$(printf '%.0f' "$context")%"; base_len=$(echo "$line2" | wc -m); rate5_seg=""; [ -n "$rate5" ] && rate5_seg=" | ⏱ 5h:$(printf '%.0f' "$rate5")%${reset_time:+ ↩$reset_time}"; rate7_seg=""; [ -n "$rate7" ] && rate7_seg=" | 📅 7d:$(printf '%.0f' "$rate7")%"; cost_seg=""; [ -n "$cost" ] && cost_seg=" | 💰 \$$(printf '%.2f' "$cost")"; elapsed_seg=""; [ -n "$elapsed" ] && elapsed_seg=" | 🕐 $elapsed"; lines_seg=""; [ -n "$lines_info" ] && lines_seg=" | ✏️ $lines_info"; full_len=$(( base_len + ${#rate5_seg} + ${#rate7_seg} + ${#cost_seg} + ${#elapsed_seg} + ${#lines_seg} )); if [ $full_len -le $cols ]; then line2="$line2$rate5_seg$rate7_seg$cost_seg$elapsed_seg$lines_seg"; elif [ $(( base_len + ${#rate5_seg} + ${#rate7_seg} + ${#cost_seg} + ${#elapsed_seg} )) -le $cols ]; then line2="$line2$rate5_seg$rate7_seg$cost_seg$elapsed_seg"; elif [ $(( base_len + ${#rate5_seg} + ${#rate7_seg} + ${#cost_seg} )) -le $cols ]; then line2="$line2$rate5_seg$rate7_seg$cost_seg"; elif [ $(( base_len + ${#rate5_seg} + ${#rate7_seg} )) -le $cols ]; then line2="$line2$rate5_seg$rate7_seg"; elif [ $(( base_len + ${#rate5_seg} )) -le $cols ]; then line2="$line2$rate5_seg"; fi; printf '%s\n%s' "$line1" "$line2"
